title: Increase in Reports of Elder Abuse and Neglect during COVID-19 Pandemic
what_it_is: Increase in Reports of Elder Abuse and Neglect during COVID-19 Pandemic

sections.label: Elder abuse cases and measures
sections.summary: Elder abuse cases at Family Service Centres rose from 232 in 2019 to 338 in 2021, while APS cases did not increase; MSF raised awareness.

sentences.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Social and Family Development (a) whether there has been an increase in the number of reports of elder abuse and neglect over the COVID-19 pandemic period; and (b) what are the additional measures and resources that the Ministry has put in place to safeguard the safety and wellness of such vulnerable seniors.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: There has been an increase in the number of cases with elder abuse as the primary presenting issue in Family Service Centres (FSCs), from 232 cases in 2019, to 283 cases in 2020 and 338 cases in 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Abuse, neglect or self-neglect cases that are higher risk in nature are typically taken up by MSF's Adult Protective Service, or APS, or by community-based Family Violence Specialist Centres (FVSCs) and PAVE Integrated Services for Individual and Family Protection Specialist Centre (ISIFPSC).

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Cases involving vulnerable adults aged 65 and above investigated by APS during the COVID-19 period also did not increase.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: There were 127 cases in 2019, 96 cases in 2020 and 120 cases in 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: New cases taken up by FVSCs and PAVE involving elder or vulnerable adult abuse decreased during this period.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: There were 85 cases in 2019, 71 cases in 2020 and 39 cases in the first nine months of 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: MSF stepped up efforts to raise greater awareness of elder abuse and neglect, including through the public education efforts held in conjunction with World Elder Abuse Awareness Day on 15 June each year.

sections.label: Increased check-ins on vulnerable clients
sections.summary: APS and partners increased check-ins on more vulnerable clients via telephone, video calls and home visits for urgent or high-risk cases.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: During this time, APS and its partners increased the frequency of check-ins on the more vulnerable clients through a combination of telephone and video calls, and home visits for cases assessed to be more urgent or high-risk in nature.
